intent: Inside a named Castle Rock HOA, what does that association's own design guidelines actually require for artificial turf, on top of whatever the Town allows?
distinctValue: Castlewood Ranch is the one named subdivision in this batch with a readable HOA design-guidelines document. Its own text sets a face-weight floor for artificial turf that the Town's ColoradoScape rule never mentions: 65 oz. minimum in the front yard, 50 oz. in the back, professionally installed. That is additional to, not instead of, the Town's no-front-yard / 500-square-foot-back rule for homes permitted after 1 January 2023 already on the page.

sources.label: Castlewood Ranch Design Guidelines (adopted 29 April 2000, amended 9 February 2021)
supports: Artificial turf is permitted. It must be a minimum of 65 oz. face weight (front yard) and 50 oz. (backyard) and professionally installed.

unresolved: The guidelines list named artificial-turf and seed products by brand; the page must not reproduce that list (site rule: no product or vendor names).
